title: Embodied Core Profile v0.1
principle: What is worth carrying when I also have a body?

omitted_concepts.person_generic: A present person can point to self or another participant.
omitted_concepts.eye_look: Gaze or pointing to the eyes supplies the reference live.
omitted_concepts.clothing: The wearer or visible garment supplies the reference.
omitted_concepts.body: The body is present and can be indicated directly.
omitted_concepts.size: Hands or body can show scale in live interaction.
omitted_concepts.color: A user can point to the actual visible color.
omitted_concepts.direction: Pointing, gaze, and placement can supply direction.
omitted_concepts.communication: Speech, gesture, or a shown phone can supply the channel.
omitted_concepts.context_icons: Paris, Nightlife, and other context concepts layer as packs.

status: RECOMMENDED PROFILE / NOT A SEPARATE ICON LIBRARY
